topics.label: Welcome and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory framing, learning objectives, and structural overview for the lecture on cancer evolution.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Mechanisms in Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how Darwinian natural selection acts on driver mutations and reversible epigenetic alterations to confer competitive fitness during clonal expansion.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the cancer stem cell model and investigate how normal tissue hierarchies and the cell of origin influence malignant transformation across different cancer types.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Promotion of Stemness
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how environmental stimuli and chronic inflammation act as promoters by signaling incipient tumor cells to adopt stem-like states.

topics.label: Established Tumor Microenvironments, Spatial Profiling, and Coevolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine stromal dependencies in established tumors, the spatial technologies used to resolve these interactions, and the resulting evolutionary framework of cancer progression.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding housekeeping and an outlook on the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
